description: This file contains unit tests for the CatalogItem API endpoint, specifically testing retrieval of catalog items by ID.

classes.name: CatalogItemGetByIdEndpointTest
classes.description: Unit tests for the GET endpoint of catalog items by ID, verifying proper responses for valid and invalid IDs.

methods.name: ReturnsItemGivenValidId
methods.description: Tests that retrieving a catalog item with a valid ID returns the correct item.

methods.name: ReturnsNotFoundGivenInvalidId
methods.description: Tests that retrieving a catalog item with an invalid ID returns a 404 Not Found.
